description: Concentric radial bars whose unfilled track is a soft tint of each bar's own color.
overview: Concentric radial bars where the unfilled part of each track is a soft tint of the bar's own color instead of neutral gray. Choose it over the default radial chart for a more colorful look that still shows how far each bar has to go.
usage: Replace `chartData` and add each category to `chartConfig`; the tinted tracks are built from the same data. Set `MAX` to the value that should close a full ring, and keep it at or above your largest value.
notes: The tracks are a second chart layered behind the real one and hidden from assistive technology, so keep the sizing shared between both when you change it.
